snippet.title: Watch Out: Shark! - Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch Out: Shark! – Official Game Trailer by Blue Monkey.

n Watch Out: Shark!, you control a little fish who needs to survive in the ocean. Escape from bigger fish, eat smaller ones to grow and score points, but watch out for the shark!

Five game modes, plus local multiplayer for up to 4 players in both cooperative and competitive modes!

Add it to your Steam Wishlist and download the free demo today!
Demo and Wishlist at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4423230/Watch_Out_Shark/
